If you are a movie lover I would point you towards considering buying a used 1080p HD plasma TV. They are still considered the best TVs amongst AV enthusiast. Second to only the very best OLED sets which cost thousands of dollars. The difference between a 7+ year old top-of-the-line plasma and today's very best 4k LCD or LED set is substantial. The plasma will have a far better picture quality. This is due to the difference in technology. Plasma and OLED have self Illuminating pixels meaning that each pixel is its own light source. LED and LCD are backlit screens. Basically the back of the TV is a big flashlight. Plasma and OLED have black levels which led and lcd simply are not capable of achieving. This is very important in the world of monitors. They are also capable of producing reference level color accuracy which no LCD or LED can do. I could go on about this for a long time but you are probably not interested. You can find a awesome 60" plasma for $100 to $300 completely blow away any 4K LCD or LED set because it is simply much better technology. The only reason they stopped making them is because they are expensive to produce and heavy. Something else to consider is 95% of content is still in 1080p HD and will continue to be so for many years. 1080p content will always look better on a 1080p TV. On 4K stats in ATP content has to be up converted to 4K and this lessens the picture. Content always looks best displayed at its native resolution.
